digest.component_or_area: pending-binding recovery gate in run_differs outbound
propositions: preview and legacy --mode dry-run passes perform remote Jira add_label and set_entity_property writes during pending-binding recovery despite being documented as no-write
the recovery gate in run_differs._run_differs_outbound is gated only on scoped_ids with no persist/no-write axis condition, unlike the sibling invariant-filing gate which composes both axes
preview passes mutate remote Jira bindings but discard the local binding-store record due to persist=False, creating an unrecoverable inconsistency
the fix suppresses remote recovery writes on no-write passes by adding ctx.persist condition while leaving live pass recovery unchanged
a regression test drives _run_differs_outbound with keyed-pending binding on persist=False pass and asserts zero remote identity writes
